title: Model link type v1
description: config/model/links/<name>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1): one kind of trace link. A link is stored on the object that knows it, from `from` to `to`, and records the target's fingerprint; it is suspect when the fingerprint changes.

name.description: The link name, equal to the file name.

from.description: The types a link of this kind may start from.

to.description: The types it may point to.

oslc.description: The OSLC property it corresponds to, when one exists (oslc_rm:satisfiedBy, ...).
